description: Answer the six questions of Steve Krug's trunk test (Don't Make Me Think) from a page's markup: what site is this, what page am I on, what are the major sections, what are my options at this level, where am I in the scheme of things, how can I search. Pass a public `url` (fetched safely, public hosts only) or `html`/`text` (pasted markup or page text). Looks at the title tag, site name meta, header logo and home link, h1, nav landmarks, breadcrumb markup and BreadcrumbList data, aria-current and active classes, and search forms. Each question comes back answerable, partial or missing with the evidence found. Reads static markup only: it cannot see layout, prominence, script-built menus or how the page looks at arm's length, so it supports the real paper test and does not replace it.

html.description: Page HTML, or plain page text. Use this, text or url.

name: trunk_test
title: Trunk test
